mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines more than housing starts (HOUST) in the same period, it signals manufacturing oversupply relative to housing demand, reducing corporate profit margins and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines more than HOUST, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above $450 billion signals robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds $450 billion, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 850,000 units signals reduced residential construction activity that weakens economic growth, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls < 850.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines below 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate is below 5.5% and payroll employment growth exceeds 200,000 jobs, it signals a tight labor market that triggers wage inflation and monetary tightening, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage pressures
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.5% and PAYEMS > 200.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.
